teacherPlan.subjectExplanation: An embedded system is a computer system designed for a specific function or limited set of functions within a larger device or system. Characteristics vary by application.
teacherPlan.teacherOnlyGuidance: Do not present classification as a simple device-name checklist; use purpose and system context.
